'''Drayson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was one of the commanders during the [[Korriban Incursion]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperial forces.<ref name="Korriban" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Drayson appears as one of the four Republic commanders that must be killed in the Imperial version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Korriban Incursion," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Republic players, Drayson is replaced by Commander [[Keikodi]], and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="Korriban" />
